mechanism_families.representation: Observation-indexed standard-Borel laws and one recognition-independent Markov channel at fixed (r_*,X), with X_A outside the channel.
mechanism_families.core_mechanism: Integrate the same normalized C_A against fixed generation, selected posterior versions, and correlated recognition.
mechanism_families.invariant_or_obstruction: Normalization, observation marginal, posterior version status, and absolute continuity survive one common channel; split channels are outside the mechanism.
obligations: Prove the parent regular-conditional identity at the observation-kernel level, not from one fixed slice.
mechanism_families.bridge: Bounded test functions, Tonelli, and standard-Borel kernel composition.
mechanism_families.failure_test: A pushed posterior that fails the global test-function disintegration or a parent null event made positive by recognition.
open_gaps: No cross-X factorization through X_A and no patchwise family are proved.
mechanism_families.novelty_fingerprint: observation-indexed laws + one common Markov channel + global RCP test-function bridge + fixed-X structural separation + full parent datum

mechanism_families.core_mechanism: Disintegrate the pushed generative law to prove induced normalized jointly measurable evaluator existence; for the predeclared tier, assume normalization, joint measurability, and explicit almost-sure compatibility before deriving the parent factorization.
mechanism_families.invariant_or_obstruction: Standard-Borel disintegration produces only an almost-sure conditional version; it does not validate an arbitrary predeclared family or regularize its presentation quotient.
obligations: Keep induced and predeclared tiers separate and preserve the null-version caveat.
mechanism_families.bridge: Disintegration of (B_A,O,H_A) conditional on (M_A,Xi_A) under the pushed parent law.
mechanism_families.failure_test: Task 4 swaps the evaluator on positive model mass while preserving a normalized model marginal.
open_gaps: Injectivity, standard-Borel quotient structure, smooth quotient structure, and cross-X sufficiency remain unproved.
mechanism_families.novelty_fingerprint: kernel-family presentation + induced-or-compatible conditional mechanism + a.s. seam obstruction + fixed-X evaluator bridge + evaluation obligations

mechanism_families.representation: Two joint channel lifts of the fine recognition/posterior pair on Y_I x Z_A.
mechanism_families.core_mechanism: Factor the joint-lift Radon-Nikodym derivative and disintegrate relative entropy into parent and discarded-conditional terms.
mechanism_families.invariant_or_obstruction: The extended identity is additive in [0,+infinity]; ordinary subtraction is not used.
obligations: Avoid infinity-minus-infinity and retain the unchanged finite evidence representative.
mechanism_families.bridge: Standard-Borel conditional laws, Radon-Nikodym factorization, and KL disintegration.
mechanism_families.failure_test: A common channel violating the additive extended-nonnegative chain rule.
open_gaps: Finite-tier equality and recovery are handled by a separate mechanism family.
mechanism_families.novelty_fingerprint: joint lifts + conditional KL chain + extended-additive invariant + evidence-representative bridge + VFE-chain obligation

mechanism_families.representation: Typed source/target holonomy groupoid actions on complete fine and parent random spaces without constructing a quotient space.
mechanism_families.core_mechanism: Intertwine full laws, selected posterior versions, C_A, and evaluation to derive covariance by kernel integration.
mechanism_families.invariant_or_obstruction: General arrows yield covariance between slices; same-slice invariance requires the fixed-(o,X) stabilizer, and a regular kernel-presentation quotient is not inferred.
obligations: A concrete parent invoking blindness supplies every full-law, version, channel, and evaluator hypothesis.
mechanism_families.bridge: Equivariant kernel integration on typed source and target spaces.
mechanism_families.failure_test: A fully equivariant source datum whose pushed full law is not covariant, or invariant marginals whose full joint changes.
open_gaps: No regular quotient, membership selector, or converse from marginal stabilization is proved.
mechanism_families.novelty_fingerprint: typed full-law groupoid actions + equivariant pushforward + quotient-regularity obstruction + evaluator bridge + blindness obligations

mechanism_families.representation: Differentiable deterministic moving-map special case or observable operators for Markov semigroups.
mechanism_families.core_mechanism: Use the full moving-map chain rule; exact Markov closure is semigroup intertwining, while a generator criterion additionally requires an invariant domain or core, semigroup generation, and a uniqueness or closure theorem lifting it to the semigroups.
mechanism_families.invariant_or_obstruction: Static law pushforward does not produce semiconjugacy, autonomy, selected membership, feedback, persistence, or physical time.
obligations: Later approximate results must declare a norm, state class, interval, residual bound, and propagation estimate.
mechanism_families.bridge: Ordinary chain rule, or Markov semigroup intertwining with any generator formulation justified by explicit generation and domain/core hypotheses.
mechanism_families.failure_test: A purported adaptive closure omitting partial_t c_t or a generator identity lacking domains and semigroup closure.
open_gaps: Autonomy, dynamic membership, Wheelerian feedback, sustained nonequilibrium, and operational time remain OPEN.
mechanism_families.novelty_fingerprint: moving deterministic map or Markov observables + semiconjugacy/intertwining mechanism + static-dynamic obstruction + declared-domain bridge + scope obligation

mechanism_families.representation: A measurable observation-indexed selected fine posterior kernel and its common-channel pushforward.

mechanism_families.invariant_or_obstruction: Regular conditionals are version-defined on null observations; global disintegration does not make a null-slice value canonical.

mechanism_families.failure_test: A nonmeasurable pushed observation kernel, a bounded-test-function disintegration failure, or an arbitrary unselected null-slice evaluation.

mechanism_families.representation: Discarded conditional laws and one reverse Markov kernel for a fixed recognition/posterior pair.
mechanism_families.core_mechanism: Use KL's zero criterion for the forward implication and two directions of data processing for the finite converse.

mechanism_families.bridge: Conditional equality, selected posterior reverse kernel, and finite data-processing equality.
mechanism_families.failure_test: Zero defect with unequal discarded conditionals, or a claimed family-wide decoder that depends on the family member.
open_gaps: Experiment-level common recovery requires simultaneous parameter-family hypotheses.
mechanism_families.novelty_fingerprint: discarded conditional equality + pairwise reverse kernel + finite data-processing invariant + experiment-recovery obstruction + equality obligation
